meta.title: Quality Assurance
meta.description: UNC drives continuous improvement of its academic and institutional processes through evaluation, accreditation and educational quality assurance systems.

hero.title: Quality Assurance
hero.label: Academics · Quality
hero.description: UNC is committed to the continuous improvement of its educational standards. The quality assurance area coordinates evaluation, accreditation and institutional development processes.

a1.title: Institutional self-assessment
a1.description: Periodic self-assessment processes that identify strengths, weaknesses and improvement opportunities in the core functions of the university.

a2.title: Program accreditation
a2.description: Support for faculties in national and international accreditation processes before bodies such as ANEAES and ARCUSUR.

a3.title: Quality indicators
a3.description: Indicator system to monitor and evaluate educational quality: completion rate, graduation, teaching performance and student satisfaction.
